subject: [PATCH v8 15/30] mm: swap in PMD swap entries as whole THPs during swapoff

2026-10-02.patch_summary: This patch modifies the behavior of the swapoff operation to handle PMD (Page Map Directory) swap entries as whole THPs (Transparent Huge Pages). The existing implementation would only consider PTEs, leading to incomplete swapoff operations. The patch introduces a new function `swap_pmd_cache_lookup` to classify PMD swap entries and map them back in as one THP, preserving soft-dirty, exclusive, and UFFD state. If the PMD entry is split or has per-page zswap state, it falls back to PTE handling.
